76ers' Joel Embiid denies tardiness report, questions why it happened: 'It feels like I'm an easy target'

Following a preseason loss to the Brooklyn Nets, Philadelphia 76ers center Joel Embiid described the rejected report about LeBron James laying into the big man for showing up a couple minutes late to Sixers practice as "unfortunate," according to ESPN's Dave McMenamin.

The one-time NBA MVP also questioned why it happened, pondering postgame Thursday night, per McMenamin: "It feels like I'm an easy target."

Box Office: ‘Other Mommy’ Spooks Up $12.6 Million on Opening Day, ‘The Social Reckoning’ Debuts to $2.15 Million on Friday

Following major openings like “Obsession,” “Backrooms” and “Resident Evil,” the horror genre’s 2026 box office reign shows no sign of slowing. And with Halloween right around the corner, it makes sense that momentum continued Friday as the supernatural, unnerving thriller “Other Mommy” easily claimed the top spot.

The Universal movie, produced by Blumhouse-Atomic Monster, generated $12.6 million from 3,365 North American theaters on Friday. It’s a strong start for the Jessica Chastain-led horror, which carries an $18 million price tag.

redstar.html:
“天眼深度游”调查：付费可自驾到核心区，有住酒店游客竟带电子设备上“锅圈”拍照

红星新闻 2026-10-10 21:31

“天眼”，即500米口径球面射电望远镜（Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical radio Telescope，简称FAST），是世界上口径最大、灵敏度最高的单天线射电望远镜，其捕捉的，是来自宇宙深处极其微弱的电磁信号，主要用于探索宇宙起源和演化、搜寻地外文明（外星人）、探测引力波等前沿科学研究。

为保护它不被任何无线电干扰，以其台址为圆心，半径30公里区域设为电磁波宁静区。《贵州省500米口径球面射电望远镜电磁波宁静区保护办法》规定：禁止擅自携带手机、平板电脑等无线电发射设备或产生电磁辐射的电子产品进入“中国天眼”核心区；无关车辆不得进入核心区。
